EmailTemplate.description: Sent by DataTeamEnrichNotifier (invoked from the Opportunity master flow) when an Opportunity is created on an Account with an incomplete billing address. The [[MISSING_FIELDS]] token is NOT a merge field - it is substituted after render by DataTeamEnrichNotifier with only the fields actually blank. Do not remove or reformat that token. Rendered against the Account, so only Account merge fields resolve.
EmailTemplate.name: Data Team Enrich Account
EmailTemplate.subject: Account {!Account.Name} is not complete
